context: A uni student debates a teacher about defense policy
purpose: Teach: 安保/締結/国防/是正/阻止/後期/公認/他国

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生、後期のゼミで日米安保について発表したいんですが、構いませんか？
lines.en: Professor, I'd like to present on the Japan-US security treaty in the late-term seminar, is that okay?
lines.style: Polite student request, slightly nervous and eager

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 面白いテーマね。でも、ただ条約締結の歴史をなぞるだけでは物足りないわよ。
lines.en: Interesting topic. But just tracing the history of the treaty signing won't be enough, you know.
lines.style: Calm teacher tone, gently challenging the student

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: もちろんです。僕は今の国防予算の偏りを是正すべきだと主張するつもりです。
lines.en: Of course. I plan to argue that the current imbalance in the defense budget should be corrected.
lines.style: Confident undergraduate stating his thesis firmly

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: なるほど。じゃあ、他国からの脅威をどう阻止するかという視点は入れるの？
lines.en: I see. So will you include the perspective of how to block threats from other countries?
lines.style: Probing question from teacher, testing his depth

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、抑止力だけに頼るのは危険だと思います。外交で衝突を阻止する道もあるはずです。
lines.en: Yes, I think relying only on deterrence is dangerous. There should also be a diplomatic path to prevent conflict.
lines.style: Earnest argument, passionate but measured tone

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 理想は分かるけど、政府公認の防衛白書を読んだ上で言ってるのかしら？
lines.en: I understand the ideal, but are you saying that after actually reading the government-approved defense white paper?
lines.style: Sharp skeptical push-back from the teacher today

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 読みました。だからこそ、現状の制度を変えていく必要があると感じたんです。
lines.en: I have read it. That's exactly why I felt the current system needs to be changed.
lines.style: Defending his position respectfully but firmly

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いい答えね。発表が楽しみよ。資料はちゃんと一次資料を当たりなさい。
lines.en: Good answer. I'm looking forward to your presentation. Make sure to consult primary sources for your materials.
lines.style: Warm but firm closing remark from teacher
